Welcome to Cyrus Says!
On this episode of Cyrus Says, Sahil Khattar joins Cyrus Broacha for a chaotic conversation about football, hosting, films, relationships and everything in between.
Sahil talks about getting the chance to host FIFA World Cup coverage, how the entire broadcast was put together in just 10 days, and what it was like working alongside names like Sunil Chhetri, Bhaichung Bhutia, Gurpreet Singh Sandhu and Sandesh Jhingan. He also opens up about his sporting background in roller hockey, and how that helped shape the way he understands football.
